(2) Two friends join her; a girl wearing a black baseball cap and a boy in a patterned knit shirt. They stand together in the same parking lot, smiling and giving thumbs up. The lighting remains bright, with high-rise buildings and a clear night sky visible behind them. (3) The scene shifts to the front of 'Mae Ploy Traditional Thai Noodles' with glass doors and wooden tables. Then, a close-up shot shows a bowl of dry noodles topped with minced meat, a soft-boiled egg, and green onions. The lighting is warm and bright indoor lighting. (4) A montage shows all three characters eating. Alicia slurps noodles with chopsticks, the girl in the cap tastes soup from a spoon, and the boy nods while chewing. They are seated in a bright restaurant with wooden furniture and white tiled walls. (5) The scene moves to a cafe the next morning. Alicia wears a white top, and the girl in the cap holds her stomach with a pained expression. Alicia runs toward the restroom doors in the background. The setting is bright with natural light from large windows. (6) Alicia exits the restroom, waving and smiling while talking. The girl in the cap then walks toward the restroom. They are in a stylish cafe with a black-and-white checkered floor and dark grey wall accents. (7) The boy is seated at the table, clutching his stomach and grimacing in pain. Alicia points at him while laughing. He eventually runs toward the restroom as the girl in the cap exits. Finally, he steps out of the restroom looking relieved.
